text:
Maya: Heads-up — deploybot blocked rc-27. vuln-scan flagged a transitive low-severity issue in libfast. Legal wants evidence before we continue. /assign @Jamal

DeployBot: Release rc-27 blocked by policy 'vuln-scan'. Finding: libfast (transitive) CVE-2026-0001 severity=LOW. Rule: transitive-low -> require provenance + reviewer sign-off. See: https://ci.internal/vuln/rc-27

Jamal: grabbing scanner output and SBOM now, on it. ETA ~10m

Rob: If it's LOW transitive, can we timebox a pin for canary rather than full rollback? want to avoid blowing the window.

Claire: Agree with Rob — security prefers pin+canary if patch not urgent and impact is low. But legal needs chain-of-trust and an explicit review note.

Ellie (Legal): Legal: please post the artifact signatures and SBOM provenance. We need to record the decision and the rationale (why low severity is acceptable for a timeboxed canary).

Jamal: Pasted scanner excerpt and SBOM link:
```
-- vuln-scan results --
libfast v1.2.3 (indirect via lib-net v0.9.1)
CVE-2026-0001 severity: LOW
exploitability: low
fix-available: no upstream patch yet
recommendation: monitor / patch when available
```
SBOM: https://artifacts.internal/sboms/rc-27/sbom.json
Signature: cosign:sha256:abc123...

Rob: Thanks. Ops: what's the canary carveout we can do safely?

OpsBot: Recommend 10% canary in us-west for 2 hours, health check 30s, auto-rollback on >3% error increase or latency spike >250ms. Will apply routing rule if approved.

Maya: Proposed decision: pin libfast to 1.2.3 in the canary image, start 10% canary for 2h. If no errors and no regressions, escalate to 50% then full. Document decision here for audit.

Claire: +1 from Security — we've reviewed impact surface, low severity, no exploitability seen. Approving timeboxed canary.

Ellie (Legal): Legal sign-off: acceptable with these constraints and audit trail. Please include the SBOM URL and cosign signature in the release notes and retention archive.

Jamal: Done — created a tiny change to lock dependency in the release image and uploaded signed SBOM to archive. Link: https://artifacts.internal/sboms/rc-27/sbom-locked.json

Maya: Okay team — proceeding with canary pin as described. @DeployBot kick off the canary once Jamal's lock is in main.

DeployBot: Canary rollout started at 1759992510. Route: rc-27-canary-us-west 10%. Health checks: enabled. Monitor channel: #prod-alerts.

Maya: I'll watch metrics and will call rollback immediately if OpsBot conditions trigger. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Rob: Documenting for release notes: "Timeboxed canary due to transitive vuln (CVE-2026-0001). SBOM and signature archived: https://artifacts.internal/sboms/rc-27/sbom-locked.json"

Maya: Closing thread — will update when canary promotes or rolls back.
